input: Shadow a local city council meeting this month

gold.taskTitle: Shadow a Local City Council Meeting This Month
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to attend and observe a local city council meeting sometime this month.

questions.title: Which city or municipality's council do you want to attend?
questions.description: Identify the specific city, town, or district council the user intends to observe.

questions.title: Have you ever attended a council meeting before?
questions.description: Understand the user's experience level so the plan can account for orientation steps if needed.

questions.title: What is your main reason for shadowing the meeting?
questions.description: Clarify the purpose, such as civic curiosity, research, journalism, school assignment, or career interest.

questions.title: Do you have a specific meeting date already in mind?
questions.description: Determine whether the user has a target date or needs help identifying upcoming meeting schedules.

questions.title: Will you be attending in person or watching a live stream?
questions.description: Establish the format of attendance to tailor logistics accordingly.

questions.title: Do you want to take notes or produce any output afterward?
questions.description: Find out if the user plans to document observations, write a report, or simply absorb the experience.

questions.title: Is there a particular agenda topic you hope to observe?
questions.description: Determine if the user wants to target a meeting covering a specific issue, such as zoning, budget, or local policy.
